_about: Entra Policy Suite - every right of every identity, ONE list (framework RIGHTS-1.6 / NAMING-PROGRAMME-1, owner 2026-11-09: "each solution must know exactly what is needed for each identity"). The install grants from it ADD-ONLY (missing -> added, read back; a right outside it is reported, never removed - owner 2026-11-09 "i have not approved any removal of graph rights ... then we can talk about clean-up later"); the setup steps verify against it; the security pack prints it; tests/Test-EpsRights.ps1 fails when code grants a right not listed here. SQL object grants per role are in sql/eps-grants.json (tested both ways by Test-EpsSqlGrants) - this file names the role. Scopes: <rg> = the install's resource group; <acr>, <kv>, <st>, <sql> = the install's registry, key vault, storage account, SQL server. 'when': always | a feature switch (granted when the customer turns it on; turning it off removes nothing - framework RIGHTS-1.7 point 5). 'featureKey': on every conditional right, the optional component it belongs to (machine key; tests/Test-EpsRights.ps1).

identities.note: Only for the guest case: EPS's hybrid worker on a server that also runs another product's worker; otherwise the server's own managed identity holds these rights. The AD writes are made by the worker's gMSA (through <gMSA>-PermissionGroup at the domain root, set up by Initialize-EpsHybridWorkerAd - HYBRID-AD-1), not by this identity.

onPremises._about: The hybrid worker's ON-PREMISES rights (validated in the worker code: engine/_shared/EPS-AdDirectory.ps1, EPS-AdDelegation.ps1, EPS-HybridWorker.ps1, tools/eps-hybrid-worker/*). Nothing is created, deleted or moved in AD: the worker only READS users and group membership and WRITES the tag attributes (extensionAttribute1-15) of user objects. Owner 2026-11-09 (HYBRID-AD-1): "normally the perm is on the root folder, not the user ou ... extensions are individual per customer ... it must be consistent".
